name: Plexus screen template contracts
scope: Frontend concept templates. These contracts describe UI meaning, not implemented backend guarantees.
constraints: Identify the task, responsible person, execution host, provider account, and actor separately.
Display host connectivity independently from the agent turn state and task outcome; a disconnected host can leave the outcome unknown.
Keep shared file and diff views read-only.
Attach the original actor and a delivery receipt to input addressed to an agent.
Separate requests for human help from instructions addressed to an agent.
Tie each approval to one named action with its scope and requesting actor.
A responsibility handoff keeps execution on the current host.
Link summaries and claims to inspectable source events, files, or results.
Reject agent input that names a stale turn, and keep interruption requested until the host acknowledges it.
Project access covers existing history and future tasks; revocation for an unreachable host can remain pending.
Label sample setup, access, and encryption states as concept behavior; do not imply live guarantees.

templates.name: Shared workspace shell
templates.purpose: Keep task context and operational ownership visible around every shared-work screen.

slots.name: navigation
slots.content: Plexus lockup, workspace breadcrumb, current task, local profile

slots.name: taskRail
slots.content: Task list, selected task, contextual files or destinations

slots.name: ownership
slots.content: Responsible person, execution host, provider/account, host connectivity

slots.name: main
slots.content: One selected screen template

slots.name: inspector
slots.content: Sources, discussion, activity, or a decision related to main content

semantics: Use an explicit selected-navigation label and aria-current.
Host status must not imply that an agent is running or idle.
Use text with every presence or status indicator.
Changing screens must preserve the selected task unless the user selects another task.

templates.name: Review together
templates.purpose: Let teammates inspect a shared change, discuss it, and send attributed corrections to the executing agent.

slots.name: heading
slots.content: Change title and task name

slots.name: attributedDirection
slots.content: Human actor, instruction, timestamp, target agent, delivery receipt

slots.name: artifact
slots.content: Read-only diff with file path, line numbers, additions and removals

slots.name: verification
slots.content: Latest check label, result, time, and source action

slots.name: discussion
slots.content: Attributed human and agent messages and separately labelled help requests

slots.name: composer
slots.content: Recipient, turn target, instruction field, send action, resulting receipt

semantics: State which agent and turn receive input before sending.
Keep the sender attribution when presenting delivered input.
Do not show delivery success until the data source confirms it; demo receipts must be identified as simulated.
Use added/removed markers as well as color in the diff.
Reject a stale-turn command instead of silently redirecting it to the current turn.
Keep interruption in a requested state until acknowledged; a disconnected host does not prove that execution stopped.
Resolving human help does not approve an agent action.

templates.name: Evidence and catch-up
templates.purpose: Explain what changed and let a reader inspect the records supporting each claim.

slots.name: scope
slots.content: Task and time or event range covered

slots.name: summary
slots.content: Concise description with linked sources

slots.name: records
slots.content: Actor, event type, timestamp, result, and stable event label

slots.name: detail
slots.content: Inspectable source body, file excerpt, test output, or delivery record

slots.name: followup
slots.content: Open review, inspect change, or request clarification

semantics: A summary is a reading aid; preserve access to the underlying records.
Distinguish agent claims from recorded verification outcomes.
Keep unavailable evidence visible as unavailable instead of fabricating a source.
Display the covered range or update time so freshness is understandable.

templates.name: Scoped decision
templates.purpose: Collect an explicit decision about one agent action or one responsibility handoff.

slots.name: request
slots.content: Requesting actor, task, action or command, timestamp

slots.name: scope
slots.content: Files/resources affected, execution host, provider account, reason

slots.name: evidence
slots.content: Source record and inspectable supporting context

slots.name: actions
slots.content: Explicit approve/reject or confirm/cancel controls

slots.name: receipt
slots.content: Decision maker, exact decision, timestamp, and resulting state

semantics: Approval covers only the displayed action; never imply a blanket permission grant.
Show a neutral alternative and prevent duplicate decisions; the first valid approval decision wins.
For a handoff, name both people and explicitly keep the same execution host.
A demo approval changes local sample state; it does not execute the command.

templates.name: Attention inbox
templates.purpose: Help a teammate find and resolve the human requests and decisions that need their attention.

slots.name: filters
slots.content: All, help, approvals, or equivalent explicit categories

slots.name: items
slots.content: Request kind, originating actor, task, summary, age, status

slots.name: detail
slots.content: Selected request and supporting context

slots.name: response
slots.content: Type-appropriate reply, review, approve, reject, or resolve action

semantics: Help, approval, and agent-delivery events must retain distinct labels.
Opening a request does not resolve it.
Do not turn a human reply into agent input without an explicit send action.
Keep resolved or decided items understandable through their receipts.

templates.name: Setup and access
templates.purpose: Explain the workspace, host, provider, and membership relationships before shared work begins.

slots.name: workspace
slots.content: Workspace and repository identity

slots.name: host
slots.content: Execution machine, owner, connection state, concept setup action

slots.name: provider
slots.content: Provider and account associated with execution

slots.name: members
slots.content: Membership/access roles and invited or joined states

slots.name: capabilityNotice
slots.content: Clear boundary between demonstrated UI and future connected/security behavior

semantics: Do not present a workspace login as provider authentication.
Name the machine that will execute work.
Explain that a responsible person and an execution host are different concepts.
Explain that project-level access includes existing history and future tasks.
Keep revocation pending for an unreachable host rather than claiming immediate removal everywhere.
Label encryption, invitations, access enforcement, and provider setup as unimplemented concept behavior in this prototype.

extensions.desktop: Project navigation and task feed; selected task conversation beside recorded results above 1100px.
extensions.narrow: Existing results view, explicit discussion drawer and mobile navigation drawer.
semantics: Remember only opaque task/project/host identifiers scoped to account and team; validate current access before replay.
Never retarget an unsent draft when the selected project or host changes.
Local provider login does not establish configured execution readiness.
Home-feed status is last-read history; host connectivity is independent.
